trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Vehicle showrooms display their stock behind glass — the trophy fires when you drive a displayed car out through the showroom front instead of using the door. Pick a showroom, get into a display vehicle and floor it through the window; the glass-through exit is the classic style the description asks for. Expect a wanted response, but the escape is not part of the requirement — the smash itself is the unlock, and showrooms are repeatable free-roam targets.

Do not chase it early; by the time the strands, challenges and 100% grind are done the counter is usually close — check the stats menu and top up with replayed mission choices.

It is a free-roam trick, repeatable until it lands; expect a wanted response, which you can shake or ignore since the escape is not required.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills are heat-carrying cash from robberies; your contacts launder them into clean money, and $250,000 must pass through the process. Rob banks, armored trucks and shops to stockpile marked bills, then visit the laundering contacts the story introduces and run batches through them. The counter is cumulative, so spread it across the campaign — the robbery trophies naturally feed this one, and the clean money funds Treat Yo Self and Little Boxes.
